user.title: Connect to MusicFlow
user.description: Enter your MusicFlow server address and API key. The API key can be created in MusicFlow under Settings → Account.

zeroconf_confirm.title: MusicFlow discovered
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found {name} at {url}. Enter an API key to finish setup.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate MusicFlow
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {url} is no longer valid. Enter a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the MusicFlow server. Check the address and that the server is running.

abort.already_configured: This MusicFlow server is already configured.

play_content.name: Play content
play_content.description: Resolve a MusicFlow library item into a queue and play it on the selected player.

content_type.name: Content type
content_type.description: Kind of library item to play.

content_id.name: Content ID
content_id.description: MusicFlow identifier of the item. For genre, use the genre name.

start_index.name: Start index
start_index.description: Index of the track to start from.

enqueue.name: Enqueue
enqueue.description: Append to the current queue instead of replacing it.

play_mode.name: Play mode
play_mode.description: order = sequential, one = repeat one, all = repeat all, shuffle = random.

clear_queue.name: Clear queue
clear_queue.description: Remove all tracks from the player queue.

no_current_song_for_playlist.message: No song is currently playing and no song_ids were provided.

no_transferable_queue.message: There is no play queue to transfer.

fetch_queue_failed.message: Failed to fetch the play queue: {error}
